_comment: PER-REGION EMPIRE tile of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment, placed by the paired-anchor-dot workflow (user idea, 2026-08-14). The whole-map fit of this source is impossible — it draws different regions at inconsistent scale, so no single warp reconciles it (see the landmark-accuracy wall). Instead the user cropped the Empire out (alpha-erasing Norsca/Bretonnia/Estalia/Tilea) and drew 9 matched colour dots on the crop AND on terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, which IS the canvas/mask frame (8192x3616). The dot centroids, recovered by exact RGB, give 9 source<->canvas correspondences; a thin-plate through them places the Empire exactly at every dot. objective=landmarks means NO silhouette fit (the drift-prone stage), just the interpolation. master_shape is the crop's native (h,w) = (1167,1149); the source is the dot-free, alpha-masked crop. This record only PLACES the tile (like old_world_black_white_colored); no geometry is extracted yet.
_comment_lattice: 6x6 over the crop (~190 master px spacing). The 9 dots cluster in the Empire interior + north/west coast; the lattice regularises the thin-plate and captures its affine trend out to the crop corners, where it extrapolates beyond the dot hull. The dot-free south-central band (below the green/blue dots) is the one extrapolated strip.
_comment_landmarks: source px = dot centroid in the crop's own 1149x1167 frame; canvas px = the SAME dot's centroid read straight off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png (= canvas space, no globe-fit indirection). Paired by the colour the user drew. These ARE the fit (not a held-out check) for objective=landmarks.

record.notes: Empire crop of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment ('The Old World, all faction starting positions v3.0'), registered against tools/derived/land_sea_mask.png by tools/fit_registration.py --seed tww3_old_world_mod_parchment_empire (objective=landmarks; 9 user-drawn paired anchor dots read direct off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png; 6x6 lattice). A DENSE Old World boundary network confined to the Empire — the whole-source fit is defeated by its inconsistent inter-region scale, so this per-region carve is the way in. Contributes NO coastline (the mask remains the sole authority, user decision #1) and no geometry yet: this request only PLACES it. precedence/layer_precedence are provisional placement values, to be revisited when boundary extraction lands (S6). MACHINE-FITTED; re-derive from the seed, do not hand-edit.
